_note: Short visual symptom descriptions, one per raw DPD disease name (175). Written by Claude from general plant-pathology knowledge (colour, lesion shape, margin, rings/halos, signs such as powder or pustules), NOT checked against the official DPD text descriptions. Each disease name is shared across crops, so descriptions describe the typical look rather than one host. Replace with DPD's own descriptions if they become available.
